g.text: How good is the security scanner on its own, before TriageBot?
Semgrep 1.178.0, ruleset p/java, recorded scan from 18 Oct 2026, 04:11 (local time), 1,909
OWASP Benchmark v1.2 answer key, 2,740 test cases
970 were real vulnerabilities and 512 were false alarms: precision
It caught 970 of 1,415 real vulnerabilities: recall
Noise to remove: 512 of 1,482 flagged test cases (34.5%) are false alarms.
Recall ceiling: TriageBot can only filter alerts, never add them, so the system can catch at most
Blind spots (nothing caught): Insecure cookie (0 of 36), Weak randomness (0 of 218).
100 SQL injection (CWE-89) test cases from the development split: 50 real vulnerabilities, 50 false alarms.
Precision: of the test cases Semgrep flagged, the share that are real vulnerabilities.
Recall: of the real vulnerabilities, the share Semgrep flagged.
An alert counts only if it names the same weakness the test case targets (CWE match).
